DEPARTMENT OF FORESTS AND WILDLIFE
NOTIFICATION
Delhi, the15th October, 2025
F.No.11162/TO(S)/TC-Felling/2023-24/9378.— WHEREAS, an application ID No.
11162 on DPTA e-Forest portal was received by the Tree Officer (South Forest Division) from The
Executive Engineer, Flyover Project Division F-21, PWD for seeking permission under the Delhi
Preservation of Trees Act, 1994 (Delhi Act 11 of 1994) (hereinafter referred to as DPTA, 1994) for
transplantation / felling of 93 number of trees for proposed construction of Elevated Corridor over
Barapullah Nallah starting from Sarai Kale Khan to Mayur Vihar, (Phase-III), New Delhi in an area
of 3.6043 hectare.
AND WHEREAS, the Tree Officer (South Forest Division) after due application of mind,
has sought exemption in respect of 3.6043 hectare area (as per details in Annexure - A) under
Section 29 of the DPTA, 1994 from applicability of Section 9 sub-section (3) of the DPTA, 1994, in
view of limitation of maximum one hectare area for considering application of tree felling /
transplantation by the Tree Officer (South Forest Division) in Section 9 sub-section (3) of the
DPTA, 1994.
THEREFORE, in exercise of the powers conferred by Section 29 of the DPTA, 1994, the
Lt. Governor of National Capital Territory of Delhi, hereby, in public interest, exempts an area of
3.6043 hectare (as per details in Annexure - A), from the limitation of maximum one hectare area
under sub-section (3) of Section 9 of the said Act for proposed construction of Elevated Corridor
over Barapullah Nallah starting from Sarai Kale Khan to Mayur Vihar, (Phase-III), New Delhi.
With the following conditions:
1) This notification is being issued under Section 29 of the DPTA, 1994 only to exempt the 3.6043
hectare area (as per details in Annexure - A) from the limitation of maximum one hectare area
under sub-section (3) of Section 9 of the DPTA, 1994 for construction of Elevated Corridor over
Barapullah Nallah starting from Sarai Kale Khan to Mayur Vihar, (Phase-III), New Delhi, as
sought by the Tree Officer (South Forest Division).
2) This notification for exemption under Section 29 of the DPTA, 1994, in any case, shall not be
considered as permission for felling / transplantation of trees under the DPTA, 1994.
3) The application for transplantation / felling of tress shall be considered and scrutinized
independently and separately by the Tree Officer (South Forest Division) under the provisions of
the DPTA, 1994, the Delhi Preservation of Trees Rules, 1996, relevant guidelines, directions
issued in this regard and all relevant court orders with due application of mind minimizing the
number of affected trees to be transplanted / felled from within the exempted area.

By Order and in the Name of the Lt. Governor of
National Capital Territory of Delhi,
VIJAY KUMAR BIDHURI, Secy.(Environment &Forests)
